text:
laura: Repro report: onboarding bulk-embed runner (batch=48, concurrency=10) is producing two waves of 429s on first-run with latest node SDK. Minimal repro attached.

sam: can you paste the client snippet?

laura: sure:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, maxConcurrency: 10 });
await client.embeddings.bulkCreate({ inputs: chunks, batchSize: 48 });
```

hiro: quick read: looks like a combination of (A) no token-aware semaphore so many large batches count as 1 slot, (B) bulk endpoints ignore Retry-After header, (C) backoff uses tiny jitter. That creates synchronized retries.

laura: logs show edge returning Retry-After: 2s, but SDK retries after internal backoff nearly simultaneously -> second spike.

sam: action list idea:
- SDK: honor Retry-After for bulk endpoints (accept seconds and HTTP-date formats).
- SDK: switch bulk endpoints to full jittered exponential backoff.
- SDK: make semaphore token-aware: estimateTokens(batch) consumed on acquire so big batches reduce parallelism.
- Sample app: change onboarding defaults to batch=24, concurrency=3 and expose RW_ONBOARD_FAST=true opt-in.
- Add an adaptive window in sample that halves concurrency for the first N requests and grows if no 429s are observed.

hiro: also propose a quick mitigation: implement a separate retry queue with lower priority so retries can't starve forward progress and don't deadlock with paginators. Add e2e harness that fakes Retry-After to assert spread.

devx-bot: DX-5017 "onboard: bulk retry waves -> adaptive window & parity" created and assigned to @sam

ops: infra note: edge will continue to return Retry-After. We can temporarily relax onboarding token bucket but prefer SDK fixes to avoid config churn.

laura: I tested locally: lowering concurrency to 3 + enabling jitter removes the second wave. Adaptive window sounds nice for sample-app UX.

sam: I'll draft the Node SDK PR to: parse Retry-After, add full jitter for bulk, and change semaphore to account for token estimates. I'll include unit tests for Retry-After HTTP-date parsing.

hiro: parity: ensure Go/Android/iOS mirror these semantics. I'll add checklist to the ticket.

laura: sample PR will add --warmup-mode that runs with conservative defaults and prints a note about tradeoffs in quickstart. Also will add DEBUG guidance: set DEBUG=sdk:throttle and include X-RW-CLIENT-SLOTS header for infra correlation.

sam: good. We'll coordinate releases so quickstart and SDK updates land together. If anyone finds other warmup patterns hitting quotas, paste logs here.
